content.text:
To set up a unified (combined) inbox in Thunderbird so all your accounts' emails appear together:

**Steps:**

1. In the folder pane (left sidebar), click the **folder mode selector** — it's the small icon at the very top of the folder pane (next to "New Message"). In your screenshot it's the icon just above the account list.

2. From the dropdown, choose **"Unified Folders"** (you may also see it called "Unified View").

That's it — Thunderbird will then merge folders of the same type across all accounts. You'll see a single **Inbox** that contains messages from every account, plus unified **Drafts**, **Sent**, **Trash**, etc. Expanding any unified folder shows the per-account sub-folders underneath.

**Alternative path** (if the icon is hidden):
- Menu button (☰ top right) → **View** → **Folders** → **Unified**.

**Tips:**
- To switch back, repeat the step and pick **"All Folders"**.
- Only accounts with standard folder types get merged. If a folder isn't appearing, check Account Settings → *Copies & Folders* to confirm it's mapped correctly (e.g., your "封存" folder won't auto-merge with others since it's a custom name).
- For finer control, you can also create a **Saved Search** (File → New → Saved Search) across selected inboxes if you want a custom subset rather than everything.
